method.background: Use disjoint six-second excerpts from two local native AMI captures. Require at least 1.2 seconds of overlapping annotated speakers overall and overlap for at least half of the edit. Mix the same background at 0 and -5 dB, measured over the six-second host clip.
method.comparison: Retain the highest flagged two-second result of the current five-window PCM check. Only consider one-second candidates wholly inside that range. Reuse the frozen dense-response point, and choose the largest dense response, with earlier ties. Require half of the edit covered and at least 0.30 IoU. The nested rule can change the shown range only.
method.controls: Replace the same words with the publisher-rendered words or a duration-matched round-trip resampling of the original words. Use a shared gain, 20 ms fades, exact samples outside the changed interval, matched unedited files and isolated real meeting audio.
method.source: Select eight distinct PhonemeDF prompt readers by hashed order from the existing qualified publisher prefixes. Match the whole publisher word tier across real speech, MeloTTS and Chatterbox TTS, exclude exact named historical source inputs, and select one or two words in two length strata. Publish prior reader exposure separately. Each reader supplies one native six-second host crop.
